newsitem.title: CHINA: China Construction Bank tightens grip on loans.
newsitem.headline: China Construction Bank tightens grip on loans.

text.p: The China Construction Bank has issued new rules to tighten its grip on granting loans in 1997, the Financial News said on Friday.
Loans to build luxury villas, hotels and office buildings would be forbidden, it said.

The use of credit to speculate in shares or other types of investment was also forbidden while all branches should follow the state-set interest rate to attract deposits and were not allowed to set higher rates, it said.
Loans should be used to help construction of lower-tier residential building projects, it said.
Anyone breaking the regulations would be severely punished, it quoted bank president Wang Qishan as saying.
